name: Amato
summary:
Welcome to Amato!

Play as a forest spirit able to possess objects and guide kokedamas — small endangered plant spheres — to fertile lands! Tilt the environment, master gravity, and protect nature!

A blend of puzzles and precision challenges
Switch between exploration phases with clever environmental puzzles and skill-based courses where agility and timing are key.

A vibrant, evolving world
Use weather effects, physics, and biome-specific mechanics to overcome obstacles and unravel the forest’s mysteries.

A colorful and relaxing atmosphere
Immerse yourself in a cozy universe inspired by traditional Japan, with warm visuals and a smooth, jazzy soundtrack.

Accessible yet demanding gameplay
Easy to pick up, but offering real challenges for players who seek perfect mastery of every course!
